nodes.description: Contract owner address, set in constructor from msg.sender and changeable via transferOwnership.
Counter of the current game round, incremented in startNewGame.
Accumulated ETH contributed by all players in the current game; updated by unchecked addition.
Pending/next ContractParam configuration (totalSize, singlePrice, pumpRate, hasChange).
Active ContractParam configuration used by addPlayer and gameResult.
Dynamic array of participating player addresses for the current game.
Payable constructor: sets owner, initializes setConfig/curConfig and starts the first game.
onlyOwner function that replaces owner with a non-zero new owner address.
onlyOwner payable function that stages new totalSize, singlePrice and pumpRate into setConfig.
Private function: increments gameIndex, applies pending setConfig changes to curConfig and clears addressArray.
Payable entry point requiring exactly curConfig.singlePrice, pushes msg.sender into addressArray and triggers game end.
View function returning gameIndex, curConfig fields, addressArray and totalPrice.
Private view function counting how many times msg.sender appears in addressArray.
Private settlement function: picks a winner pseudorandomly, splits the contract balance between owner and winner using transfer, then emits GameOverEvent with now.
Private view function deriving a winner index from keccak256 of block.timestamp, blockhash and player addresses.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender == owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, player registration and self-count checks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp (now) used as randomness seed and in the GameOverEvent.
owner.transfer(giveToOwn) external value transfer executed inside gameResult.
lastAddress.transfer(giveToActor) external value transfer to a player-derived address inside gameResult.
addressArray.push(msg.sender) unbounded growth of the players array.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(ramdon, now, blockhash(block.number-1))) weak, miner-influenceable randomness.
totalPrice = totalPrice + msg.value unchecked arithmetic accumulation.
Constructor parameter _totalSize used to initialize the initial ContractParam.
Constructor parameter _singlePrice scaled by 1 finney into the initial ContractParam.
transferOwnership parameter newOwner.
changeConfig parameter _totalSize written into setConfig.
changeConfig parameter _singlePrice scaled by 1 finney into setConfig.
changeConfig parameter _pumpRate written into setConfig.
Locally computed winner index returned by getRamdon.
Address of the selected winner read from addressArray.
Snapshot of address(this).balance used to compute the payout split.
Owner share computed as totalBalace * curConfig.pumpRate / 100.
Winner share computed as totalBalace - giveToOwn.
Accumulated keccak256 randomness value used modulo addressArray.length.
Counter of how many entries in addressArray equal msg.sender.
Loop index over addressArray in getSelfCount.
Final index = uint(ramdon) % addressArray.length returned by getRamdon.

edges.reason: Constructor calls startNewGame to initialize the first round.
owner is assigned from msg.sender in the constructor.
_totalSize initializes setConfig.totalSize.
_singlePrice * 1 finney initializes setConfig.singlePrice.
onlyOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against owner.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable as the authorization baseline.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership against non-owner callers.
onlyOwner guards changeConfig against non-owner callers.
newOwner is written into the owner state variable without renouncing checks.
transferOwnership mutates owner to the new address.
_totalSize is staged into setConfig.totalSize.
_singlePrice * 1 finney is staged into setConfig.singlePrice.
_pumpRate is staged into setConfig.pumpRate.
changeConfig sets curConfig.hasChange = true to mark pending updates.
startNewGame reads setConfig fields to refresh curConfig.
startNewGame updates curConfig totalSize, singlePrice, pumpRate and hasChange.
startNewGame resets addressArray.length to 0.
Any msg.sender can call addPlayer.
addPlayer requires msg.value == curConfig.singlePrice.
totalPrice = totalPrice + msg.value can silently overflow on accumulation.
The previous totalPrice value is read before the unchecked addition.
addPlayer feeds msg.value into the totalPrice accumulation.
msg.sender is pushed into addressArray without limits.
The push mutates the addressArray state variable.
addPlayer reads addressArray.length to decide game end.
addPlayer calls gameResult when addressArray.length >= curConfig.totalSize.
addPlayer calls startNewGame right after settling the game.
gameResult indirectly reads addressArray to select the winner.
gameResult calls getRamdon to obtain the winner index.
block.timestamp (now) is used as a randomness seed, creating timestamp dependency.
getRamdon builds its weak randomness from now and blockhash.
getRamdon iterates over addressArray to mix in player addresses.
getSelfCount compares msg.sender against every addressArray entry.
getSelfCount reads the addressArray state variable.
gameResult performs owner.transfer external value call during settlement.
gameResult performs lastAddress.transfer to an attacker-influenced address.
giveToActor is the exact amount forwarded to the winner address.
giveToOwn is the exact amount forwarded to the owner address.
giveToOwn = totalBalace * curConfig.pumpRate / 100 unchecked multiplication.
lastAddress is the destination of the winner payout transfer.
The index local is computed as ramdon % addressArray.length inside getRamdon.
The ramdon local accumulates keccak256 hashes in getRamdon.
The index returned by getRamdon is used to index addressArray in gameResult.
lastAddress winner is resolved inside gameResult.
GameOverEvent emits now, making the event timestamp dependent.
count local tracks matches found in getSelfCount.
Loop index i drives the getSelfCount iteration.
getGameInfo returns gameIndex.
getGameInfo returns curConfig totalSize, singlePrice and pumpRate.
getGameInfo returns totalPrice.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor-only parameter that flows straight into the initial ContractParam initialization.
Constructor-only price parameter scaled into setConfig and curConfig at deploy time.
Parameter exists only to update the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
Owner-supplied value staged into setConfig.totalSize by changeConfig.
Owner-supplied price staged into setConfig.singlePrice by changeConfig.
Owner-supplied payout rate staged into setConfig.pumpRate by changeConfig.
Temporary winner index consumed immediately within gameResult for the payout computation.
Temporary winner address used only as transfer destination inside gameResult.
Temporary balance snapshot used only for the payout split inside gameResult.
Computed owner share is passed directly as the value of owner.transfer.
Computed winner share is passed directly as the value of lastAddress.transfer.
Accumulator local holding the weak keccak256 randomness derived from timestamp and blockhash.
Return local computed as ramdon % addressArray.length inside getRamdon.
Loop counter local used only inside getSelfCount.
Iteration index local used only inside getSelfCount.
